JANUS HENDERSON FUND MANAGEMENT UK LIMITED
THE HENDERSON FAR EAST INCOME LIMITED
The Company announces that it agreed on 11 November 2026 to allot 175,000 ordinary shares at a price of 250.0p per share.
These shares will be issued for cash on 12 November 2026, bringing the issued share capital and total voting rights at that date to 243,429,679.
Janus Henderson Secretarial Services UK Limited
